macros.name: appopenDoc
macros.doc: Opens a document and return a Doc object.

macros.name: certifyInvisibleSign
macros.doc: An invisible signature field is created and signed using the method Doc.certifyInvisibleSign().

macros.name: DeclareJSHelper
macros.doc: A general purpose command for defining what I am calling JavaScript helper commands.

macros.name: docSaveAs
macros.doc: Saves a PDF or converts a PDF to another format to a specified path.

macros.name: executeSave
macros.doc: To save the document, use at the end of the doc assembly environment.

macros.name: mailDoc
macros.doc: Attach the current PDF and email it someone.

macros.name: signatureSign
macros.doc: The function \signatureSign takes the info in the oSigInfo object, gets the security handler object, logs into the handler, calls signatureSetSeedValue if the sv property is in the oSigInfo object, and signs the field.

macros.name: theDocObject
macros.doc: The command \theDocObject is normally set to this, meaning the current document.

envs.name: docassembly
envs.doc: The docassembly package defines the docassembly environment in which JavaScript code can be written to execute once and only once the newly created PDF in the Acrobat application.
